protocol.scope: No-refit numerical reproduction of the two selected minimal Kallenberger 2014 average-cell SBML artifacts in an independent external solver. This protocol freezes inputs and decisions; it does not execute a trajectory, import a model into MEHLISSA, or establish biological qualification.

shared_model_semantics.assignment_rule: CD95act = (CD95^3 * KDL^2 * CD95L) / ((CD95L + KDL) * (CD95^2 * KDL^2 + KDR * CD95L^2 + 2 * KDR * KDL * CD95L + KDR * KDL^2))

stimulus.publication_mapping_note: The BioModels documentation relates 16.6 to 500 ng/mL CD95L and labels it 16.6 nM, but the SBML artifacts omit explicit substance and concentration units. BCQ-1.3 therefore executes the numeric value unchanged and does not perform an SI conversion.

unit_policy.rule: BCQ-1.3 must preserve source numbers exactly and must not label the time axis as seconds or minutes, nor state values as molar or SI concentrations. A later pre-outcome amendment may add a biological unit mapping only from a citable source or curator task configuration and must retain the unconverted run.

solver.name: COPASI command-line engine (CopasiSE)
solver.dependency_role: optional scientific reproduction tool, not a MEHLISSA runtime dependency

acceptance_rules.source_identity: Before import, both downloaded files must match their frozen SHA-256 hashes and Git commits. Any mismatch is a failed protocol run, not an invitation to update the expected hash.
acceptance_rules.import_structure: COPASI must import each unchanged SBML artifact with one compartment, 18 species, 13 reactions, 12 global parameters, and one assignment rule and report no fatal semantic error.
acceptance_rules.complete_output: Each run must contain exactly 961 ordered model_time rows from 0 through 240 and the four primary observables, with no missing, NaN, or infinite numeric value.
acceptance_rules.initial_state: At model_time zero every recorded species must equal the frozen SBML initial value within absolute tolerance 1e-12.
acceptance_rules.deterministic_replay: After canonical numeric parsing, the primary and replay runs for the same artifact must have zero maximum absolute and relative difference at every frozen grid point.
acceptance_rules.numerical_convergence: For every primary observable and grid point, primary-versus-tightened absolute difference must be no greater than 1e-8 + 1e-6 * max(1, abs(tightened_value)).
acceptance_rules.conservation: For every declared invariant and grid point, absolute residual from its frozen initial total must be no greater than 1e-10 + 1e-8 * max(1, abs(initial_total)).
acceptance_rules.nonnegativity: Every species value must be at least -1e-10 * max(1, largest absolute initial value for that artifact).
acceptance_rules.reporter_direction: PrER_mGFP and PrNES_mCherry must be non-increasing, allowing only the same scale-aware 1e-8 relative numerical margin used for conservation.
acceptance_rules.publication_alignment: Quantitative publication-curve acceptance is BLOCKED because no rights-cleared machine-readable reference series has been frozen. Visual similarity to an article or BioModels report may be recorded only as descriptive context and cannot pass this gate.

reference_and_claim_policy.source_artifact_reference: The unchanged CC0 BioModels SBML equations and initial values are the machine reference for BCQ-1.3 numerical execution.
reference_and_claim_policy.publication_reference: Kallenberger et al. 2014 and BioModels curation support biological context and reported qualitative similarity, but no figure or experimental row is redistributed by this protocol.
reference_and_claim_policy.allowed_after_bcq_1_3_if_all_unblocked_r: The frozen public average-cell SBML artifacts were independently executed in COPASI with reproducible, numerically converged trajectories and source-derived invariants.
forbidden_after_bcq_1_3: claiming quantitative reproduction of a published curve without a frozen numeric reference
claiming the wild-type average-cell artifact is the complete held-out population prediction
claiming biological qualification, normal endothelial behavior, organ realism, patient prediction, diagnosis, treatment response, safety, or clinical validity
changing parameters, initial values, units, solver settings, observables, tolerances, or failure rules after inspecting a trajectory without a versioned pre-outcome amendment

negative_controls.test: alter one source-file byte or expected SHA-256
swap the 523 and 524 role or initial-value set
change CD95L, any initial value, kinetic parameter, or assignment rule
execute a different COPASI version, build, commit, method, or tolerance without an amendment
label model_time as seconds or minutes or convert state values to SI without an approved mapping
omit, duplicate, reorder, or truncate a frozen time row or primary observable
inject NaN, infinity, a conservation violation, or material negative state
enable optimization, parameter estimation, or outcome-informed tuning
describe visual agreement, an average-cell run, or same-paper 525/526 sensitivity as independent biological validation

result_archive.non_overwriting_run_id: UTC timestamp plus protocol SHA-256 prefix
result_archive.failure_retention: All started runs, logs, partial outputs, deviations, and failed gates remain in their original non-overwriting archive.

decision.amendment_rule: Any material change after this commit requires a new protocol version committed before inspecting new trajectory outcomes; the original protocol and later failed or superseded results remain traceable.
